requirements.criterion: Refuse, accept real provider contract, craft actual item, claim points once, learn and lease, use then upgrade new output; disconnect retains method.
Construct inspection apparatus with real inputs and learned method; fixed preservation same revision used for provisions and dispatch.
Earn cache in actual custody; opening-time deterministic seeded commitment yields two useful native items; appraisal reports possibilities, duplicate keep/sell; retry and import stable.
Earn stake, funded rival escrow, fold or continue, draw bound before decision but hidden, settle both purses once; tool purchase consequential.
Configure/run/alter model; only knowledge exported; actual irrigation job consumes real inputs, comparison changes output.
Qualify current authored worlds; actual compatible existing consumer if supported, otherwise precise incumbent pack/adapter gate retained.
Teach registered NPC; own resources/clock produce retained output after teacher leaves, scoped response; no player-resource borrowing.
Rebuilt fresh-origin natural journey plus alternate failures; old save, save/reload/import, failed write, replay and malformed-state proof.

laterExclusions: All unselected variants within selected leaves
Body conversion, new worlds/starts, generic NPC economies, arbitrary matter creation, real pocket habitats
Fortune manipulation, automated wagers, universal pity/slots/caps
Whole-book completion, private pack changes without current qualification
